summary.text: Kathy KL Tran is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 18th District, which covers part of Fairfax County, and has served since 2018.
Tran sits on the House committees on Health and Human Services; Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources; Rules; and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Kathy KL Tran was born in Vietnam, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Tran's education as Duke University, NC (B.A., History, 2000) and University of Michigan, MI (M.S.W., 2003).

Tran's listed memberships and affiliations include Temple B'nai Shalom; West Springfield Elementary School PTA (former president); Springfield District Democratic Committee; West Springfield Women Marchers Huddle.
